_comment: C0-17 正文英译 · fish-audio（2026-10-26）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」4 行带 .md 链接（elevenlabs/minimax-audio/heygen/whisper），related 写 4 条（frontmatter related 是 [elevenlabs, minimax-audio, heygen]，键按正文链接行对齐=4——whisper 行在正文但不在 frontmatter）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 带「实测建议」三条段。

axes.model_access: A self-developed speech-synthesis model line (fish speech series models narrative, official site); a community voice library (zero-shot cloning + a user-shared voice marketplace) is one of the product's main axes. Open-weights line: fish audio's predecessor project has an open-source precedent; the current product line's weight-openness status not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (fish.audio) + API (official docs line); generation on the vendor's cloud.
axes.local_files: Generated outputs download to local; the voice library lives on the account/community side. No officially stated local data surface seen.
axes.background: Generation is instant/task-based (API calls produce and return immediately); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" form stated — a cloud service does not depend on your machine being online.
axes.tools: TTS (multilingual), zero-shot voice cloning (upload a sample and it clones — the product's signature), a voice marketplace (community-shared voice line), emotion/style control (official-site narrative); the API surface is documented.
axes.context: Tool-type with no conversation memory; voice assets are the "consistency" mechanism — cloned voices are reusable, that is not product memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription + API system (D9: pricing not collected); **the authorization and abuse-defense lines of zero-shot cloning are a must-answer item** — the official terms carry consent framing (terms page direct-fetched on record), enforcement-mechanism details not verified item by item (inclusion criterion 3).
axes.fit: Fits: zero-shot voice-cloning workflows (fast replication of your own voice), treasure-hunting community voices, developer API integration. Does not fit: cloning other people's voices (authorization red line), enterprise-grade compliance narrative first, mainland direct connection (measured 000).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Zero-shot cloning fidelity on ~10-second samples**
- **Actual enforcement of clone-abuse defenses** (celebrity-voice test — only to verify the defense exists)
- **Consistency of commercial-use labeling in the community voice marketplace**
unknowns:
- The registered entity and team composition (no official statement verified)
- Weight-openness status of the current product line (not verified item by item)
- Training-use switch and the voice library's default training stance (not verified item by item)
- Filing status (see the cn block — entity unclear)
related: The two cloning-oriented titans: ElevenLabs carries a heavier enterprise-compliance narrative, fish audio a heavier community voice ecosystem.
Also China-background cloning lines: MiniMax connects directly + is API-heavy, fish audio needs a network path + is community-heavy.
Downstream of cloned voices: voices replicated by fish audio often feed HeyGen-class avatar platforms for narration (cross-linked after filing).
Up/downstream of the audio pipeline: Whisper transcribes in, fish audio synthesizes out — often the two ends of the same voice pipeline.
